decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on an established trommel screen that already won many customers, and it sits in the firm's core screening business, so its results likely meet the aspiration even though it has not been seen on the website since 2019.
The flail shredder line fits the mobile-processing core, and the firm's slack can still carry it, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 makes its results uncertain.

The stationary electric fine shredder had little visibility from the start and no observed presence since, so its results likely fall short of the aspiration, and problemistic search favours moving its resources to the core mobile business.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line supports the stationary plant business the firm is pursuing, and the evidence is not yet weak enough to justify releasing its resources.
